# UX & Accordion State Requirements Quality Checklist: Collapsible & Target-Only Movement Goal Cards

**Purpose**: Validate requirements completeness, clarity, consistency, and accessibility for the collapsible target-only cycle movement goal card redesign (`SPEC-CYCLE-GOAL-04`)
**Created**: 2026-11-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness & Clarity

- [x] CHK001 Are the exact quick target adjustment stepper pill increments explicitly defined for all three goal metrics (`-2.5/+2.5/+5 kg` for Weight, `-5/+5/+10 cal` for Calories, `-1/+1/+5 reps` for Reps)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK002 Is the complete removal of the `Start (<unit>)` input field and `+ →` connector from the movement goal editor card unambiguously specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK003 Are all visual elements of the `Collapsed Summary State` (`Goal <N>: <Movement Name>`, context badge, target badge, expand chevron `▾`, and delete icon `🗑`) explicitly documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK004 Are all visual elements of the `Expanded Edit State` (`Goal <N>`, `Done ▲` button, delete icon `🗑`, `Movement (Basic)` selector, single-row `Goal Metric:`, contextual RM/Time Window row, full-width `Target (<unit>)`, and 3 quick-stepper pills) explicitly documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]

## Accordion State Machine & Validation Consistency

- [x] CHK005 Are all three collapse/expand triggers (`Done ▲` / IME `Done`, `+ Movement` auto-collapse, and exclusive single-expand accordion switching) consistently specified? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, §FR-007]
- [x] CHK006 Is the initial load state for existing saved goals when opening `Edit cycle` explicitly defined as `Collapsed Summary State` by default? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK007 Is the validation behavior when attempting to collapse or switch away from an expanded card with an empty or `<= 0` `Target` value specified with exact recovery messaging (`"Please enter a target value greater than 0"`)? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK008 Is the minimum floor guardrail (`>= 0`) specified for negative quick-stepper pills (`-2.5 kg`, `-5 cal`, `-1 rep`) when `Target` is empty, `0`, or smaller than the decrement step? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-005]

## Responsive Layout, Accessibility & Backward Compatibility

- [x] CHK009 Are single-line non-wrapping layout requirements for `Goal Metric:` pills and single-line ellipsis truncation for long movement names in collapsed cards defined for `360dp` viewports? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-003, §FR-004]
- [x] CHK010 Are TalkBack merged accessibility semantics (`contentDescription`) and backward-compatible `CycleGoal` persistence / `ProgressScreen` baseline derivation (`startWeight = 0.0`) explicitly specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, §FR-009]

## Notes

- All 10 requirements-quality items (`CHK001`–`CHK010`) verified against `spec.md`, `plan.md`, `data-model.md`, and `contracts/ui-collapsible-cycle-goal-card-contract.md`.
